questions.stem: What happens to the resistance of a wire if its length is doubled?
questions.explanation: Resistance is directly proportional to length. If the length of a wire is doubled, the resistance also doubles because electrons must travel through more material and encounter more collisions with ions in the lattice.

questions.stem: What is the unit of electrical resistance?
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms (Ω). One ohm is the resistance of a component when a potential difference of 1 volt drives a current of 1 ampere through it.
